title: Dictate on the phone: proving transcription works right now, fixing what fails

chat.text: You said you are trying the mobile transcribe sheet now. A Sonnet task mastermind re-runs the headless voice walk on today's code, watches your live attempt in the Dictate logs, fixes the first thing that fails, and records how far the mobile sheet is from being the desktop sidebar's collapsed form, plus where "new session" stands.
